finding.headline: "The Second Baby Nobody Prepared Me For"
finding.problem: "For my first, Mama came for 3 months. For this one, she said 'you know better now' and stayed 1 week. My toddler is falling apart and I have no help."
finding.person: Nigerian mum on baby #2; omugwo came for #1 but NOT for #2 (PMC study: support drops for subsequent births). Toddler regresses, she's alone.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (the "subsequent-birth, no-village" angle) — DIFFERENTIATED, culturally precise". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
